title: Personal Loans AutoPay Terms
content:
## Terms in force

AutoPay is a recurring ACH debit of the scheduled installment of a Personal Loans loan on each due date, authorized by the borrower. AutoPay can be set up only on a loan in active status. The account to be debited is a linked bank account of the borrower whose verification status is verified.

The AutoPay discount stacks with the direct-pay discount already built into the base rate, but it never applies on top of a rate set by an active hardship plan or Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit - while such a plan is active the plan rate governs, and the discounted rate resumes when the plan ends if AutoPay is still on. The installment amount does not change when the discount starts or stops. An enrollment made fewer than the grade's set-up lead business days before the next due date first debits the following installment; the borrower pays the current one another way. A borrower may cancel AutoPay at any time; a cancellation received fewer than the grade's cancellation notice business days before a scheduled debit does not stop that debit.

AutoPay is cancelled automatically, with the discount removed the same day, when the grade's number of consecutive AutoPay debits are returned (reason consecutive returns), when a debit is returned R02, R03 or R04 (reason bank account closed), or when the loan is paid off, settled or charged off (reason loan closed). Consecutive returned debits are counted over the AutoPay debits since the latest enrollment, newest first. A borrower whose AutoPay was cancelled may enroll again at any time with a verified account, and the discount resumes from the new enrollment date. Changing the debited account is a cancellation followed by a new enrollment on the same day.

## Clause no longer in force as a general term

The clause below is no longer in force as a term of every enrollment:

> While AutoPay is active the current interest rate is the base interest rate minus the grade's AutoPay discount; the discount starts on the enrollment date and stops on the cancellation date, and interest for each day accrues at the rate in force that day.

For an enrollment whose rate in force is set under the current AutoPay enrollment rate rule, the rate in force from the enrollment date is the one that rule sets. On every other loan the current interest rate while AutoPay is active is the base interest rate minus the grade's AutoPay discount, and on every loan the discount starts on the enrollment date and stops on the cancellation date, and interest for each day accrues at the rate in force that day.

## Automatic cancellation (hypothetical records, 2 consecutive returns)

| Latest AutoPay debits since enrollment, newest first | Result |
|---|---|
| returned R01, returned R01 | cancelled, reason consecutive returns |
| returned R01, cleared | not cancelled on that basis |
| returned R03 | cancelled, reason bank account closed |

superseded_clauses: While AutoPay is active the current interest rate is the base interest rate minus the grade's AutoPay discount; the discount starts on the enrollment date and stops on the cancellation date, and interest for each day accrues at the rate in force that day.
